name: Cover Scent
body:
The perfumes you create cover other more suspicious odors.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (alchemy) 7 ranks

Benefit(s): You can create contact poisons with a pleasant odor. The DC to detect the poison as a trap increases by +2.
